name: Playwright
role: Headless browser automation; the capture route for every browser-rendered toolkit
summary: Browser automation library for Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. In VCR it drives headless Chromium through the shared @vcr/capture harness: seek a paused timeline, settle two animation frames, then capture each frame as PNG, including alpha, with page.screenshot (validated in p5-capture and three-capture). HeadlessExperimental beginFrame is an experimental, DOM-only alternative. Distinguishing strength: one capture path for any DOM, SVG, canvas or WebGL scene, with order-independent frames (a GSAP timeline matched under beginFrame; canvas and WebGL under screenshot).
use_when: Capturing any browser-rendered scene frame by frame, DOM, SVG, canvas or WebGL
Alpha PNG layers from HTML for a later compositor, over MP4 renderers like HyperFrames
Over canvas-record or CCapture.js when the scene is not a bare canvas or needs server-side runs
avoid_when: Native sources (Blender, Manim, FFmpeg): they render without a browser
Live screen recording with real-time audio: real-time capture drifts; seek instead
GPU-heavy WebGL where headless software rendering is too slow: test the GPU flags first
Turning frames into video: hand them to ffmpeg-ffprobe

install.macos: pnpm add -D playwright && npx playwright install chromium

notes: Not in PRD Appendix A; added because the browser-capture spike depends on it.

Use the shared @vcr/capture harness (seek, settle two animation frames, page.screenshot) for order-independent frames. HeadlessExperimental.beginFrame under --deterministic-mode is experimental and DOM-only: it hangs on canvas and WebGL pages, and an audit rerun of browser-capture exited with an unresolved await on that path; see specifications/spikes/browser-capture.md and examples/browser-capture/README.md.
2026-10-26: HeadlessExperimental is a Chrome DevTools domain flagged experimental upstream and may change; re-check after Playwright or Chromium upgrades.

assessment.rationale: Release 1.64.1 on 2026-10-14, Apache-2.0, pushed daily by Microsoft. The 2026-10-26 browser-capture validation ran the then-default beginFrame route (experimental CDP domain, DOM-only). The current default, seek, two-frame settle and screenshot, is evidenced by p5-capture and three-capture; browser-capture has no recorded run on it.

evidence.result: 90 alpha frames; shuffled order matches sequential

Default screenshot route (seek, two-frame settle, screenshot): 90 frames at 1080p, shuffled matches sequential; 30 frames at 4K hashed, not checked; frame 45 alpha printed min 0 max 1 (not asserted); about 10 fps at 1080p, single run. Env: Linux x86_64 container, Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 headless shell standing in for pinned build 1248, ImageMagick 6.9.12-98 via convert shim.
evidence.scope: First recorded run of the current default route (seek, settle, screenshot) for browser-capture; Linux container, Chromium 153 stand-in, not pinned Chromium 156.
